summary: Implemented GeneralizedWassersteinDiceLoss in monai/losses/dice.py (after GeneralizedDiceLoss, before the alias block), added the generalized_wasserstein_dice alias, imported numpy and torch.nn.functional there, exported the class from monai/losses/__init__.py, and added tests/test_generalized_wasserstein_dice_loss.py with binary 2D and empty-class cases. Nothing was run, per instructions, so the tests are unverified; I checked the batch-of-two arithmetic by hand (TP 0.8, D 2.4, loss about 0.333). No commits were made. Known gap: a float64 numpy distance matrix against float32 logits would hit a dtype mismatch, since forward performs no dtype handling.
